## Key Financial Tools Built by Arpit Agarwala
- [SIP Calculator](https://arpitagarwala.online/projects/sip): Systematic Investment Plan wealth predictor with inflation adjustment and step-up returns calculation.
- [Budget Tracker](https://arpitagarwala.online/projects/budget): Personal financial management and expense categorization application.
- [Expense Splitter](https://arpitagarwala.online/projects/expense-splitter): Group expense division tool for trips and shared living.
- [Universal Calculator](https://arpitagarwala.online/projects/calculator): Advanced scientific and financial arithmetic calculator.
- [AI Assistant](https://arpitagarwala.online/projects/ai-assistant): Custom conversational AI assistant interface.

## Bhagavad Gita Portal
Arpit Agarwala has digitized and structured all 18 Chapters (700 Verses) of the Bhagavad Gita with Sanskrit Devanagari script, IAST transliteration, word-by-word meanings, and English commentary. Accessible at https://arpitagarwala.online/dharma/gita.
